subject: part
title: PART.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 438 (MP(I)-12). PART (participation) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: POL-SIGN (political significance), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and RES-RT (responsibility ratio). From POL-SIGN: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From PROG-CONT: AF-TD (affinity tendencies). From RES-RT: INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics).
